thread:
Ava (CEO): Good morning — quick exec weekly. Big props to Eng & Product on the Dedicated throughput improvements: p99 latency down 18% and cost/unit down ~12% this week. :tada:
Diego (VP Product): Amazing. Thanks team! Can we get a one-liner for the release notes? @Jun
Jun (VP Eng): putting one together now. Short: `batching default tuned`, `kv-cache aggressive` and kernel swaps for 4x seq workloads.
Ava (CEO): Also: heads-up on two items that need attention this sprint:
- EU private beta: compliance checklist must be finished by EOD Wed. Maya, you own gating.
- Data retention policy update: 90 -> 60 days for non-enterprise logs. Legal signoff in progress.
Maya (Head of Ops): On EU beta — checklist is 80% done. Need confirmation on backup window tolerances from infra.
Jun (VP Eng): backup window tolerances? We can allow 30m/day but need to throttle heavy KV flushes. Will add to infra PR.
Diego (VP Product): Product ask: highlight fallback model routing in the beta docs. Users need predictable behavior when capacity drops.
Ava (CEO): Incident note: last night's degraded embeddings for ~22m-23m UTC. Root cause: anomalous token distribution triggering a fallback loop. Ops mitigated with `route:disable-loop` at 23:12 UTC.
k8s-deploy-bot: deploy `infra/patch-2026-03-22` rolled to canary at 23:40 UTC — 4 pods. No errors in canary logs.
Maya (Head of Ops): Follow-up: we're scheduling a postmortem today at 16:00 PT. Invite sent to oncall and SRE leads.
Jun (VP Eng): I'll bring logs + hotfix notes. Recommend a small code change to break loop detection earlier.
Diego (VP Product): KPI check: weekly trial conversion up 4%, API error rate at 0.5% (trend down), token cost still target to shave 5% more.
Ava (CEO): Asks for this week:
1) Eng: submit the EU beta compliance PR by Tue EOD.
2) Product: finalize beta docs w/ fallback behavior by Wed noon.
3) Ops: confirm retention rollout plan and postmortem summary by Thu.
Quick ack with emoji so I can close this out. Thanks — Ava
Diego (VP Product): ✅ will do.
Jun (VP Eng): ✅ PR incoming.
Maya (Head of Ops): ✅ postmortem invite accepted.
Ava (CEO): Great. Also, small reminder — all managers please run 1:1s next week focused on onboarding feedback from beta teams. :memo:
